comment: PT Part 5: the Card Forge. Fuse an element (Weapon Infusion or a single-Vector spell) with a technique (Lunge, Strike-type cards, Throw, Shove, Dash) so the technique carries that Vector, or two spells into a hybrid. The fused card costs the higher cost plus fusionSurcharge; both sources are used up. Salvage gives Scraps of the card's Vectors plus generic Scraps by rarity. Upgrades and riders cost Scraps; each extra rider on a card costs more (riderEscalation).
